title: 因式分解：拆开看

starterCode:
# 因式分解验证：(x+2)(x+3) = x^2+5x+6 ?
x = 10
left = (x + 2) * (x + 3)
right = x * x + 5 * x + 6
say("左边 = " + left + "，右边 = " + right)

if left == right:
    say("分解正确！")

lab.code:
# 因式分解验证探索台：(x+2)(x+3) = x²+5x+6
x = 3   # 代入验证的值

hide()
left = (x + 2) * (x + 3)
right = x * x + 5 * x + 6
write("x = " + x, -150, 140, "blue", 13)
write("左：(x+2)(x+3) = " + left, -150, 95, "red", 14)
write("右：x²+5x+6 = " + right, -150, 58, "red", 14)
if left == right:
    write("✓ 恒等！换成任何 x 都相等", -150, 10, "green", 13)
if left != right:
    write("✗ 不相等？", -150, 10, "orange", 13)
write("乘开：(x+2)(x+3) = x²+5x+6", -150, -45, "blue", 12)
write("分解：x²+5x+6 = (x+2)(x+3)", -150, -80, "orange", 12)
